name: nested
finalText:
I opened the live page and read the frame contents. These are the exact words in each frame:

- **Top left frame:** "LEFT" (from `/frame_left`)
- **Top middle frame:** "MIDDLE" (from `/frame_middle`)
- **Top right frame:** "RIGHT" (from `/frame_right`)
- **Bottom frame:** "BOTTOM" (from `/frame_bottom`)

The accessibility-tree read timed out on two of the frames (frame-1 and frame-2). The page-text extraction returned the text of all four frames, and a screenshot showed the same four words in the same positions.
